# Image Statistics Functions[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-statistics-functions)

Primitives for computing the statistical properties of an image.

Some statistical primitives also require scratch buffer during the computation. For details, please refer to [Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer).

These functions can be found in the nppist library. Linking to only the sub-libraries that you use can significantly save link time, application load time, and CUDA runtime startup time when using dynamic libraries.

## CommonGetBufferHostSizeParameters[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__statistics__functions_1CommonGetBufferHostSizeParameters)

Common parameters for nppiGetBufferHostSize functions include:

- param oSizeROI
- param hpBufferSize
-
Required buffer size. Important: hpBufferSize is a

*host pointer.*[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). - param nppStreamCtx
- return
-
NPP_NULL_POINTER_ERROR if hpBufferSize is 0 (NULL),

[ROI Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_error_codes).

## Image Sum[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-sum)

### Sum[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__sum_1image_sum)

Primitives for computing the sum of all the pixel values in an image.

Sum

Given an image \(pSrc\) with width \(W\) and height \(H\), the sum will be computed as

[nppiSum_8u64s_C1R_Ctx](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__sum_1ga2e0254ca94d44a4080a201e7107945ca)and

[nppiSum_8u64s_C4R_Ctx](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__sum_1ga2d3cca17a193e01bd3bfd7b4d552f96e). The sum functions require additional scratch buffer for computations.

### Common parameters for nppiSum functions include:[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__sum_1CommonSumParameters)

- param pSrc
- param nSrcStep
- param oSizeROI
- param pDeviceBuffer
-
Pointer to the required device memory allocation,

[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). Use nppiSumGetBufferHostSize_XX_XXX to determine the minimum number of bytes required. - param pSum
-
Device memory pointer to the computed sum.

- param nppStreamCtx

SumGetBufferHostSize

Companion primitives for computing the device buffer size (in bytes) required by the sum primitives.

Common parameters for nppiSumGetBufferHostSize functions include:

- param oSizeROI
- param hpBufferSize
-
Required buffer size. Important: hpBufferSize is a

*host pointer.*[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). - param nppStreamCtx

- return
-
NPP_NULL_POINTER_ERROR if hpBufferSize is 0 (NULL),

[ROI Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_error_codes).

## Image Min[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-min)

### Min[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__min_1image_min)

Primitives for computing the minimal pixel value of an image.

Min

The scratch buffer is required by the min functions.

### Common parameters for nppiMin functions include:[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__min_1CommonMinParameters)

- param pSrc
- param nSrcStep
- param oSizeROI
- param pDeviceBuffer
-
Pointer to the required device memory allocation,

[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). Use nppiMinGetBufferHostSize_XX_XXX to determine the minimum number of bytes required. - param pMin
-
Device memory pointer to the computed min.

- param nppStreamCtx

MinGetBufferHostSize

Companion primitives for computing the device buffer size (in bytes) required by the min primitives.

### CommonMinGetBufferHostSizeParameters[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__min_1CommonMinGetBufferHostSizeParameters)

Common parameters for nppiMinGetBufferHostSize functions include:

- param oSizeROI
- param hpBufferSize
-
Required buffer size. Important: hpBufferSize is a

## Image Min Index[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-min-index)

### MinIndx[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__min__index_1image_min_index)

Primitives for computing the minimal value and its indices (X and Y coordinates) of an image.

MinIndx

If there are several minima in the selected ROI, the function returns one on the top leftmost position.

The scratch buffer is required by the functions.

### Common parameters for nppiMinIndx functions include:[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__min__index_1CommonMinIndxParameters)

- param pSrc
- param nSrcStep
- param oSizeROI
- param pDeviceBuffer
-
Pointer to the required device memory allocation,

[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer)Use nppiMinIndxGetBufferHostSize_XX_XXX to determine the minimum number of bytes required. - param pMin
-
Device memory pointer to the computed min result.

- param pIndexX
-
Device memory pointer to the X coordinate of the image min value.

- param pIndexY
-
Device memory pointer to the Y coordinate of the image min value.

- param nppStreamCtx

MinIndxGetBufferHostSize

Companion primitives for computing the device buffer size (in bytes) required by the MinIndx primitives.

### CommonMinIndxGetBufferHostSizeParameters[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__min__index_1CommonMinIndxGetBufferHostSizeParameters)

Common parameters for nppiMinIndxGetBufferHostSize functions include:

- param oSizeROI
- param hpBufferSize
-
Required buffer size. Important: hpBufferSize is a

*host pointer.*[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). - param nppStreamCtx

- return
-
NPP_NULL_POINTER_ERROR if hpBufferSize is 0 (NULL),

[ROI Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_error_codes).

## Image Max[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-max)

### Max[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__max_1image_max)

Primitives for computing the maximal pixel value of an image.

#### Common parameters for nppiMax functions include:[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__max_1CommonMaxParameters)

- param pSrc
- param nSrcStep
- param oSizeROI
- param pDeviceBuffer
-
Pointer to the required device memory allocation,

[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). Use nppiMaxGetBufferHostSize_XX_XXX to determine the minimum number of bytes required. - param pMax
-
Device memory pointer to the computed max.

- param nppStreamCtx
- return

Max

The scratch buffer is required by the functions.

MaxGetBufferHostSize

Companion primitives for computing the device buffer size (in bytes) required by the Max primitives.

### CommonMaxGetBufferHostSizeParameters[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__max_1CommonMaxGetBufferHostSizeParameters)

Common parameters for nppiMaxGetBufferHostSize functions include:

- param oSizeROI
- param hpBufferSize
-
Required buffer size. Important: hpBufferSize is a

*host pointer.*[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). - param nppStreamCtx

- return
-
NPP_NULL_POINTER_ERROR if hpBufferSize is 0 (NULL),

[ROI Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_error_codes).

## Image Max Index[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-max-index)

### MaxIndx[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__max__index_1image_max_index)

Primitives for computing the maximal value and its indices (X and Y coordinates) of an image.

MaxIndx

If there are several maxima in the selected region of interest, the function returns one on the top leftmost position.

The scratch buffer is required by the functions.

### Common parameters for nppiMaxIndx functions include:[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__max__index_1CommonMaxIndxParameters)

- param pSrc
- param nSrcStep
- param oSizeROI
- param pDeviceBuffer
-
Pointer to the required device memory allocation,

[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer)Use nppiMaxIndxGetBufferHostSize_XX_XXX to determine the minimum number of bytes required. - param pMax
-
Device memory pointer to the computed max result.

- param pIndexX
-
Device memory pointer to the X coordinate of the image max value.

- param pIndexY
-
Device memory pointer to the Y coordinate of the image max value.

MaxIndxGetBufferHostSize

Companion primitives for computing the device buffer size (in bytes) required by the MaxIndx primitives.

### CommonMaxIndxGetBufferHostSizeParameters[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__max__index_1CommonMaxIndxGetBufferHostSizeParameters)

Common parameters for nppiMaxIndxGetBufferHostSize functions include:

- param oSizeROI
- param hpBufferSize
-
Required buffer size. Important: hpBufferSize is a

*host pointer.*[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). - param nppStreamCtx

- return
-
NPP_NULL_POINTER_ERROR if hpBufferSize is 0 (NULL),

[ROI Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_error_codes).

## Image MinMax[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-minmax)

### MinMax[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__min__max_1image_min_max)

Primitives for computing both the minimal and the maximal values of an image.

MinMax

The functions require the device scratch buffer.

### Common parameters for nppiMinMax functions include:[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__min__max_1CommonMinMaxParameters)

- param pSrc
- param nSrcStep
- param oSizeROI
- param pMin
-
Device memory pointer to the computed minimal result.

- param pMax
-
Device memory pointer to the computed maximal result.

- param pDeviceBuffer
-
Buffer to a scratch memory. Use nppiMinMax_XX_XXX to determine the minimum number of bytes required.

- param nppStreamCtx

MinMaxGetBufferHostSize

Companion primitives for computing the device buffer size (in bytes) required by the MinMax primitives.

### CommonMinMaxGetBufferHostSizeParameters[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__min__max_1CommonMinMaxGetBufferHostSizeParameters)

Common parameters for nppiMinMaxGetBufferHostSize functions include:

- param oSizeROI
- param hpBufferSize
-
Required buffer size. Important: hpBufferSize is a

*host pointer.*[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). - param nppStreamCtx

- return
-
NPP_NULL_POINTER_ERROR if hpBufferSize is 0 (NULL),

[ROI Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_error_codes).

## Image Mean[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-mean)

### Mean[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__mean_1image_mean)

Primitives for computing the arithmetic mean of all the pixel values in an image.

Mean

Given an image \(pSrc\) with width \(W\) and height \(H\), the arithmetic mean will be computed as

### Common parameters for nppiMean functions include:[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__mean_1CommonMeanParameters)

MeanGetBufferHostSize

Companion primitives for computing the device buffer size (in bytes) required by the Mean primitives.

### CommonMeanGetBufferHostSizeParameters[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__mean_1CommonMeanGetBufferHostSizeParameters)

Common parameters for nppiMeanGetBufferHostSize functions include:

- param oSizeROI
- param hpBufferSize
-
Required buffer size. Important: hpBufferSize is a

*host pointer.*[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). - param nppStreamCtx

- return
-
NPP_NULL_POINTER_ERROR if hpBufferSize is 0 (NULL),

[ROI Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_error_codes).

## Image Mean StdDev[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-mean-stddev)

### Mean_StdDev[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__mean__stddev_1image_mean_stddev)

Primitives for computing both the arithmetic mean and the standard deviation of an image.

Mean_StdDev

Given an image \(pSrc\) with width \(W\) and height \(H\), the mean and the standard deviation will be computed as

### Common parameters for nppiMean_StdDev functions include:[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__mean__stddev_1CommonMeanStdDevParameters)

- param pSrc
- param nSrcStep
- param oSizeROI
- param pMask
- param nMaskStep
- param nCOI
- param pDeviceBuffer
-
Pointer to the required device memory allocation,

[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer)Use[MeanStdDevGetBufferHostSize](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__mean__stddev_1meanstddevgetbufferhostsize)to determine the minimum number of bytes required. - param pMean
-
Device memory pointer to the computed mean.

- param pStdDev
-
Device memory pointer to the computed standard deviation.

- param nppStreamCtx

- return
-
[Image Data Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1image_data_error_codes),[ROI Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_error_codes), or NPP_COI_ERROR if an invalid channel of interest is specified.

## Image Norms[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-norms)

### Image Norms[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__norm_1image_norm)

Primitives for computing the norms of an image, the norms of difference, and the relative errors of two images. Given an image \(pSrc\) with width \(W\) and height \(H\),

The infinity norm (Norm_Inf) is defined as the largest absolute pixel value of the image.

-
The L1 norm (Norm_L1) is defined as the sum of the absolute pixel value of the image, i.e.,

\[Norm\_L1 = \sum_{j=0}^{H-1}\sum_{i=0}^{W-1}\left| pSrc(j,i)\right|\]. -
The L2 norm (Norm_L2) is defined as the square root of the sum of the squared absolute pixel value of the image, i.e.,

\[Norm\_L2 = \sqrt{\sum_{j=0}^{H-1}\sum_{i=0}^{W-1}\left| pSrc(j,i)\right| ^2}\].

Given two images \(pSrc1\) and \(pSrc2\) both with width \(W\) and height \(H\),

The infinity norm of differece (NormDiff_Inf) is defined as the largest absolute difference between pixels of two images.

-
The L1 norm of differece (NormDiff_L1) is defined as the sum of the absolute difference between pixels of two images, i.e.,

\[NormDiff\_L1 = \sum_{j=0}^{H-1}\sum_{i=0}^{W-1}\left| pSrc1(j,i)-pSrc2(j,i)\right|\]. -
The L2 norm of differece (NormDiff_L2) is defined as the squared root of the sum of the squared absolute difference between pixels of two images, i.e.,

\[NormDiff\_L2 = \sqrt{\sum_{j=0}^{H-1}\sum_{i=0}^{W-1}\left| pSrc1(j,i)-pSrc2(j,i)\right| ^2}\].

Given two images \(pSrc1\) and \(pSrc2\) both with width \(W\) and height \(H\),

-
The relative error for the infinity norm of differece (NormRel_Inf) is defined as NormDiff_Inf divided by the infinity norm of the second image, i.e.,

\[NormRel\_Inf = \frac{NormDiff\_Inf}{Norm\_Inf_{src2}}\] -
The relative error for the L1 norm of differece (NormRel_L1) is defined as NormDiff_L1 divided by the L1 norm of the second image, i.e.,

\[NormRel\_L1 = \frac{NormDiff\_L1}{Norm\_L1_{src2}}\] -
The relative error for the L2 norm of differece (NormRel_L2) is defined as NormDiff_L2 divided by the L2 norm of the second image, i.e.,

\[NormRel\_L2 = \frac{NormDiff\_L2}{Norm\_L2_{src2}}\]

The norm functions require the addition device scratch buffer for the computations.

#### Common parameters for nppiNorm functions include:[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__norm_1CommonNormParameters)

- param pSrc1
- param nSrc1Step
- param pSrc2
- param nSrc2Step
- param oSizeROI
- param pMask
- param nMaskStep
- param nCOI
- param pNorm
-
Device memory pointer to the norm value.

- param pNormDiff
-
Device memory pointer to the computed norm of differences.

- param pNormRel
-
Device memory pointer to the computed relative error for the infinity norm of two images.

- param pDeviceBuffer
-
Pointer to the required device memory allocation,

[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). Use nppiNormInfGetBufferHostSize_XX_XXX to compute the required size (in bytes). - param nppStreamCtx
- return
-
[Image Data Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1image_data_error_codes),[ROI Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_error_codes), or NPP_COI_ERROR if an invalid channel of interest is specified, or NPP_NOT_EVEN_STEP_ERROR if an invalid floating-point image is specified.

NormInfGetBufferHostSize

Companion primitives for computing the device buffer size (in bytes) required by the Norm_Inf primitives.

#### CommonNormInfGetBufferHostSizeParameters[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__inf__norm_1CommonNormInfGetBufferHostSizeParameters)

Common parameters for nppiNormInfGetBufferHostSize functions include:

- param oSizeROI
- param hpBufferSize
-
Required buffer size. Important: hpBufferSize is a

*host pointer.*[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). - param nppStreamCtx

- return
-
NPP_NULL_POINTER_ERROR if hpBufferSize is 0 (NULL),

[ROI Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_error_codes).

NormL1GetBufferHostSize

Companion primitives for computing the device buffer size (in bytes) required by the Norm_L1 primitives.

#### CommonNormL1GetBufferHostSizeParameters[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__L1__norm_1CommonNormL1GetBufferHostSizeParameters)

Common parameters for nppiNormL1GetBufferHostSize functions include:

- param oSizeROI
- param hpBufferSize
-
Required buffer size. Important: hpBufferSize is a

*host pointer.*[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). - param nppStreamCtx

- return
-
NPP_NULL_POINTER_ERROR if hpBufferSize is 0 (NULL),

[ROI Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_error_codes).

NormL2GetBufferHostSize

Companion primitives for computing the device buffer size (in bytes) required by the Norm_L2 primitives.

#### CommonNormL2GetBufferHostSizeParameters[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__L2__norm_1CommonNormL2GetBufferHostSizeParameters)

Common parameters for nppiNormL2GetBufferHostSize functions include:

- param oSizeROI
- param hpBufferSize
-
Required buffer size. Important: hpBufferSize is a

*host pointer.*[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). - param nppStreamCtx

- return
-
NPP_NULL_POINTER_ERROR if hpBufferSize is 0 (NULL),

[ROI Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_error_codes).

- Parameters
-
**pSrc1**–[Source-Image Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1source_image_pointer).**nSrc1Step**–[Source-Image Line Step](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1source_image_line_step).**pSrc2**–[Source-Image Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1source_image_pointer).**nSrc2Step**–[Source-Image Line Step](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1source_image_line_step).**oSizeROI**–[Region-Of-Interest (ROI)](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_specification).**aNormDiff**– Array that contains computed Inf-norm of differences.**pDeviceBuffer**– Pointer to the required device memory allocation,[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer).**nppStreamCtx**–[Application Managed Stream Context](https://docs.nvidia.com/nppdefs.html#structnppstreamcontext_1application_managed_stream_context).

- Returns
-
[Image Data Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1image_data_error_codes),[ROI Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_error_codes), or NPP_NOT_EVEN_STEP_ERROR if an invalid floating-point image is specified.

NormDiffInfGetBufferHostSize

Companion primitives for computing the device buffer size (in bytes) required by the NormDiff_Inf primitives.

#### CommonNormDiffInfGetBufferHostSizeParameters[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__inf__normdiff_1CommonNormDiffInfGetBufferHostSizeParameters)

Common parameters for nppiNormDiffInfGetBufferHostSize functions include:

- param oSizeROI
- param hpBufferSize
-
Required buffer size. Important: hpBufferSize is a

*host pointer.*[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). - param nppStreamCtx

- return
-
NPP_NULL_POINTER_ERROR if hpBufferSize is 0 (NULL),

[ROI Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_error_codes).

NormDiffL1GetBufferHostSize

Companion primitives for computing the device buffer size (in bytes) required by the NormDiff_L1 primitives.

#### CommonNormDiffL1GetBufferHostSizeParameters[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__L1__normdiff_1CommonNormDiffL1GetBufferHostSizeParameters)

Common parameters for nppiNormDiffL1GetBufferHostSize functions include:

- param oSizeROI
- param hpBufferSize
-
Required buffer size. Important: hpBufferSize is a

*host pointer.*[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). - param nppStreamCtx

- return
-
NPP_NULL_POINTER_ERROR if hpBufferSize is 0 (NULL),

[ROI Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_error_codes).

NormDiffL2GetBufferHostSize

Companion primitives for computing the device buffer size (in bytes) required by the NormDiff_L2 primitives.

#### CommonNormDiffL2GetBufferHostSizeParameters[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__L2__normdiff_1CommonNormDiffL2GetBufferHostSizeParameters)

Common parameters for nppiNormDiffL2GetBufferHostSize functions include:

- param oSizeROI
- param hpBufferSize
-
Required buffer size. Important: hpBufferSize is a

*host pointer.*[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). - param nppStreamCtx

- return
-
NPP_NULL_POINTER_ERROR if hpBufferSize is 0 (NULL),

[ROI Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_error_codes).

NormRelInfGetBufferHostSize

Companion primitives for computing the device buffer size (in bytes) required by the NormRel_Inf primitives.

#### CommonNormRelInfGetBufferHostSizeParameters[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__inf__normrel_1CommonNormRelInfGetBufferHostSizeParameters)

Common parameters for nppiNormRelInfGetBufferHostSize functions include:

- param oSizeROI
- param hpBufferSize
-
Required buffer size. Important: hpBufferSize is a

*host pointer.*[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). - param nppStreamCtx

- return
-
NPP_NULL_POINTER_ERROR if hpBufferSize is 0 (NULL),

[ROI Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_error_codes).

### Image NormRel L1[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-normrel-l1)

#### NormRel_L1[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__L1__normrel_1image_L1_normrel)

Primitives for computing the relative error of L1 norm between two images.

NormRelL1GetBufferHostSize

Companion primitives for computing the device buffer size (in bytes) required by the NormRel_L1 primitives.

#### CommonNormRelL1GetBufferHostSizeParameters[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__L1__normrel_1CommonNormRelL1GetBufferHostSizeParameters)

Common parameters for nppiNormRelL1GetBufferHostSize functions include:

- param oSizeROI
- param hpBufferSize
-
Required buffer size. Important: hpBufferSize is a

*host pointer.*[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). - param nppStreamCtx

- return
-
NPP_NULL_POINTER_ERROR if hpBufferSize is 0 (NULL),

[ROI Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_error_codes).

NormRelL2GetBufferHostSize

Companion primitives for computing the device buffer size (in bytes) required by the NormRel_L2 primitives.

#### CommonNormRelL2GetBufferHostSizeParameters[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__L2__normrel_1CommonNormRelL2GetBufferHostSizeParameters)

Common parameters for nppiNormRelL2GetBufferHostSize functions include:

- param oSizeROI
- param hpBufferSize
-
Required buffer size. Important: hpBufferSize is a

*host pointer.*[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). - param nppStreamCtx

- return
-
NPP_NULL_POINTER_ERROR if hpBufferSize is 0 (NULL),

[ROI Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_error_codes).

## Image DotProd[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-dotprod)

### DotProd[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__dot__prod_1image_dot_prod)

Primitives for computing the dot product of two images.

DotProd

Given two images \(pSrc1\) and \(pSrc2\) both with width \(W\) and height \(H\), the dot product will be computed as

### Common parameters for nppiDotProd functions include:[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__dot__prod_1CommonDotProdParameters)

- param pSrc1
- param nSrc1Step
- param pSrc2
- param nSrc2Step
- param oSizeROI
- param pDp
-
Device memory pointer to the computed dot product of the two images.

- param pDeviceBuffer

Pointer to the required device memory allocation,

DotProdGetBufferHostSize

Companion primitives for computing the device buffer size (in bytes) required by the Mean_StdDev primitives.

### CommonDotProdGetBufferHostSizeParameters[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__dot__prod_1CommonDotProdGetBufferHostSizeParameters)

Common parameters for nppiDotProdGetBufferHostSize functions include:

- param oSizeROI
- param hpBufferSize
-
Required buffer size. Important: hpBufferSize is a

*host pointer.*[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). - param nppStreamCtx

- return
-
NPP_NULL_POINTER_ERROR if hpBufferSize is 0 (NULL),

[ROI Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_error_codes).

## Image Count In Range[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-count-in-range)

### CountInRange.[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__count__in__range_1image_count_in_range)

Primitives for computing the amount of pixels that fall into the specified intensity range.

CountInRange

The lower bound and the upper bound are inclusive.

The functions require additional scratch buffer for computations.

### Common parameters for nppiCountInRange functions include:[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__count__in__range_1CommonCountInRangeParameters)

- param pSrc
- param nSrcStep
- param oSizeROI
- param pCounts
-
Device memory pointer to the number of pixels that fall into the specified range.

- param nLowerBound
-
Lower bound of the specified range.

- param nUpperBound
-
Upper bound of the specified range.

- param pDeviceBuffer
-
Pointer to the required device memory allocation,

[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). - param nppStreamCtx

-
[Image Data Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1image_data_error_codes),[ROI Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_error_codes), or NPP_RANGE_ERROR if the lower bound is larger than the upper bound.

## Image MaxEvery[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-maxevery)

## Image RectStdDev[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-rectstddev)

### RectStdDev[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__rectstddev_1image_rectstddev)

Primitives for computing the standard deviation of the integral images. The function computes the standard deviation of the pixel in the rectangular window with the integral image \(pSrc\) and the squared integral image \(pSqr\), which can be obtained by calling [Integral](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__integral_1image_integral) and [SqrIntegral](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__sqrintegral_1image_sqrintegral).

The standard deviation of the pixel \((j, i)\) can be computed using the formula:

The size of the \(pSrc\) and \(pSqr\) should be \((oSizeROI.width + oRect.x + oRect.width, oSizeROI.height + oRect.y + oRect.height).\)

## Image Histogram Even[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-histogram-even)

### HistogramEven[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__histogrameven_1image_histogrameven)

Primitives for computing the histogram of an image with evenly distributed bins.

HistogramEven

The \(nLowerLevel\) (inclusive) and \(nUpperLevel\) (exclusive) define the boundaries of the range, which are evenly segmented into \(nLevel - 1\) bins.

The computed histogram is stored in \(pHist\). The levels are calculated by another primitive [nppiEvenLevelsHost_32s](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__histogrameven_1gaf60397e584d096dca93cb541d23fe44d) and are stored in a host pointer \(hpLevels\). The number of levels is also \(nLevel - 1\). The histogram \(pHist[k]\) is defined as the total number of pixels that fall into the range: \(hpLevels[k] <= pSrc(j, i) < hpLevels[k+1]\). The functions require additional scratch buffer for computations.

### Common parameters for nppiHistogramEven functions include:[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__histogrameven_1CommonHistogramEvenParameters)

- param pSrc
- param nSrcStep
- param oSizeROI
- param pHist
-
Device memory pointer to array that receives the computed histogram. The array must be of size nLevels-1.

- param nLevels
-
Number of levels.

- param nLowerLevel
-
Lower boundary of lowest level bin.

- param nUpperLevel
-
Upper boundary of highest level bin.

- param pBuffer
-
Device memory pointer to appropriately sized scratch buffer.

- param nppStreamCtx

HistogramEvenGetBufferSize

Companion primitives for computing the device buffer size (in bytes) required by the HistogramEven primitives.

- param oSizeROI
- param nLevels
-
Number of levels in the histogram.

- param hpBufferSize
-
Required buffer size. Important: hpBufferSize is a

*host pointer.*[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). - param nppStreamCtx

- return
-
NPP_NULL_POINTER_ERROR if hpBufferSize is 0 (NULL),

[ROI Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_error_codes)..

## Image Histogram Range[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-histogram-range)

### HistogramRange[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__histogramrange_1image_histogramrange)

Primitives for computing the histogram of an image within specified ranges.

HistogramRange

The histogram is computed according to the ranges provided in \(pLevels\).

The histogram \(pHist[k]\) is defined as the total number of pixels that fall into the range: \(pLevels[k] <= pSrc(j, i) < pLevels[k+1]\). The number of the histogram bins is \(nLevel - 1\). The functions require additional scratch buffer for computations.

### Common parameters for nppiHistogramRange functions include:[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__histogramrange_1CommonHistogramRangeParameters)

- param pSrc
- param nSrcStep
- param oSizeROI
- param pHist
-
Device memory pointer to array that receives the computed histogram. The array must be of size nLevels-1.

- param pLevels
-
Device memory pointer to array containing the level sizes of the bins. The array must be of size nLevels.

- param nLevels
-
Number of levels in histogram.

- param pBuffer
-
Pointer to appropriately sized (nppiHistogramRangeGetBufferSize_XX_XXX) scratch buffer.

- param nppStreamCtx

-

## Image Proximity[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-proximity)

### Image Proximity[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__proximity_1image_proximity)

Primitives for computing the proximity measure between a source image and a template image.

#### General Introduction[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__proximity_1general_introduction)

There are basically two approaches to compute the proximity measure for template matching, Euclidean distance and the cross correlation.

-
Euclidean distance computes the sum of the squared distance (SSD) between the corresponding pixels of the source image and the template image. The smaller the distance is, the more similar the source image and the template image is around the pixel. The anchor of the template

image is used during the computations, which always lies in the geometric center of the image. Given a source image

\(pSrc\) ( \(W_s \times H_s\)) and a template image \(pTpl\) ( \(W_t \times H_t\)), the Euclidean distance \(D_{st}(c,r)\) between two images at pixel in row \(r\) and column \(c\) is computed as ( \(s\) stands for source image and \(t\) for template image for short):\[D_{st}(c,r)=\sum_{j=0}^{H_t-1}\sum_{i=0}^{W_t-1}[pTpl(j,i)-pSrc(j+c-\frac{H_t}{2}, i+r-\frac{W_t}{2})]^2 \] -
Cross correlation computes the sum of the product between the corresponding pixels of the source image and the template image. The cross correlation \(R_{st}(c,r)\) is calculated as:

\[R_{st}(c,r)=\sum_{j=0}^{H_t-1}\sum_{i=0}^{W_t-1}[pTpl(j,i)\cdot pSrc(j+c-\frac{H_t}{2}, i+r-\frac{W_t}{2})] \]The larger the cross correlation value is, the more similar the source image and the template image is around the pixel. -
The cross correlation \(R_{st}(c,r)\) is affected by the brightness of the images which may vary due to the lighting and exposure conditions. Therefore, NPP computes the cross correlation coefficient to circumvent this dependence. This is typically done at every step by subtracting the mean from every pixel value, i.e.,

\[\tilde{R}_{st}(c,r)=\sum_{j=0}^{H_t-1}\sum_{i=0}^{W_t-1}[pTpl(j,i)-Mean_t]\cdot [pSrc(j+c-\frac{H_t}{2}, i+r-\frac{W_t}{2})-Mean_s] \]

NPP computes the normalized values of Euclidean distance, cross correlation and the cross correlation coefficient.

-
The normalized Euclidean distance \(\sigma_{st}(c,r)\) is defined as:

\[\sigma_{st}(c,r) = \frac{D_{st}(c,r)}{\sqrt{R_{ss}(c,r)\cdot R_{tt}(\frac{H_t}{2},\frac{W_t}{2})}} \] -
The normalized cross correlation \(\rho_{st}(c,r)\) is defined as:

\[\rho_{st}(c,r) = \frac{R_{st}(c,r)}{\sqrt{R_{ss}(c,r)\cdot R_{tt}(\frac{H_t}{2},\frac{W_t}{2})}} \]The \(R_{ss}(c,r)\) and \(R_{tt}(\frac{H_t}{2}, \frac{W_t}{2}\) denote the auto correlation of the source image and the template image individually. They are defined as:\[R_{ss}(c,r)=\sum_{j=c-\frac{H_t}{2}}^{c+\frac{H_t}{2}}\sum_{i=r-\frac{W_t}{2}}^{r+\frac{W_t}{2}}pSrc(j, i) \]\[R_{tt}(\frac{H_t}{2},\frac{W_t}{2})=\sum_{j=0}^{H_t-1}\sum_{i=0}^{W_t-1}pTpl(j,i) \] -
Similarly, the normalized cross correlation coefficient \(\gamma_{st}(c,r)\) is calculated as:

\[\gamma_{st}(c,r) = \frac{\tilde{R}_{st}(c,r)}{\sqrt{\tilde{R}_{ss}(c,r)\cdot \tilde{R}_{tt}(\frac{H_t}{2},\frac{W_t}{2})}} \]The \(\tilde{R}_{ss}(c,r)\) and \(\tilde{R}_{tt}(\frac{H_t}{2}, \frac{W_t}{2}\) are defined as:\[\tilde{R}_{ss}(c,r)=\sum_{j=c-\frac{H_t}{2}}^{c+\frac{H_t}{2}}\sum_{i=r-\frac{W_t}{2}}^{r+\frac{W_t}{2}}[pSrc(j, i)-Mean_s] \]\[\tilde{R}_{tt}(\frac{H_t}{2},\frac{W_t}{2})=\sum_{j=0}^{H_t-1}\sum_{i=0}^{W_t-1}[pTpl(j,i)-Mean_t] \]where \(Mean_t\) is the template mean minus the mean of the image in the region just under the template.

#### Categorizations[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__proximity_1category)

The Euclidean distance and the cross correlation are categorized into three types, full, same, and valid.

Full mode indicates that the anchor of the template image starts from the outside of the source image, assuming the out-of-boundary pixels are zeor-padded. The size of the destination image is \((W_s + W_t - 1) \times (H_s + H_t - 1)\).

Same mode means that the anchor of the template image starts from the top left pixel of the source image. All the out-of-boundary pixels are also zero-padded. The size of the destination image is the same as the source one, i.e., \(W_s \times H_s\).

Valid mode indicates that there are no out-of-boudnary readings from the source image. The anchor of the template image starts from the inside of the source image. The size of the destination image is \((W_s - W_t + 1) \times (H_s - H_t + 1)\).


## Image Square Distance Full Norm[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-square-distance-full-norm)

### SqrDistanceFull_Norm[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__sqrdistancefullnorm_1sqrdistancefullnorm)

Primitives for computing the normalized Euclidean distance between two images with full mode.

SqrDistanceFull_Norm

The functions compute the \(\sigma_{st}(c,r)\) in [General Introduction](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__proximity_1general_introduction) with full mode (see [Categorizations](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__proximity_1category)).

## Image Square Distance Same Norm[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-square-distance-same-norm)

### SqrDistanceSame_Norm[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__sqrdistancesamenorm_1sqrdistancesamenorm)

Primitives for computing the normalized Euclidean distance between two images with same mode.

SqrDistanceSame_Norm

The functions compute the \(\sigma_{st}(c,r)\) in [General Introduction](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__proximity_1general_introduction) with same mode (see [Categorizations](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__proximity_1category)).

## Image Square Distance Valid Norm[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-square-distance-valid-norm)

### SqrDistanceValid_Norm[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__sqrdistancevalidnorm_1sqrdistancevalidnorm)

Primitives for computing the normalized Euclidean distance between two images with valid mode.

SqrDistanceValid_Norm

The functions compute the \(\sigma_{st}(c,r)\) in [General Introduction](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__proximity_1general_introduction) with valid mode (see [Categorizations](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__proximity_1category)).

## Image Cross Correlation Full Norm[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-cross-correlation-full-norm)

### CrossCorrFull_Norm[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__crosscorrfullnorm_1crosscorrfullnorm)

Primitives for computing the normalized cross correlation between two images with full mode.

CrossCorrFull_Norm

The functions compute the \(\rho_{st}(c,r)\) in [General Introduction](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__proximity_1general_introduction) with full mode (see [Categorizations](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__proximity_1category)).

## Image Cross Correlation Same Norm[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-cross-correlation-same-norm)

### CrossCorrSame_Norm[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__crosscorrsamenorm_1crosscorrsamenorm)

Primitives for computing the normalized cross correlation between two images with same mode.

CrossCorrSame_Norm

The functions compute the \(\rho_{st}(c,r)\) in [General Introduction](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__proximity_1general_introduction) with same mode (see [Categorizations](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__proximity_1category)).

## Image Cross Correlation Valid Norm[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-cross-correlation-valid-norm)

### CrossCorrValid_Norm[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__crosscorrvalidnorm_1crosscorrvalidnorm)

Primitives for computing the normalized cross correlation between two images with valid mode.

CrossCorrValid_Norm

The functions compute the \(\rho_{st}(c,r)\) in [General Introduction](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__proximity_1general_introduction) with valid mode (see [Categorizations](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__proximity_1category)).

## Image Cross Correlation Valid[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-cross-correlation-valid)

### CrossCorrValid[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__crosscorrvalid_1crosscorrvalid)

Primitives for computing the cross correlation between two images with valid mode.

CrossCorrValid

The functions compute the \(R_{st}(c,r)\) in [General Introduction](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__proximity_1general_introduction) with valid mode (see [Categorizations](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__proximity_1category)).

## Image Cross Correlation Full Norm Level[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-cross-correlation-full-norm-level)

### CrossCorrFull_NormLevel[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__crosscorrfullnormlevel_1crosscorrfullnormlevel)

Primitives for computing the normalized cross correlation coefficient between two images with full mode.

CrossCorrFull_NormLevel

The functions compute the \(\gamma_{st}(c,r)\) in [General Introduction](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__proximity_1general_introduction) with full mode (see [Categorizations](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__proximity_1category)).

The functions require additional scratch buffer for computations.

Note: For maximum performance oSrcRoiSize.width + oTplRoiSize.width - 1 MUST be an integer multiple of 4.

FullNormLevelGetBufferHostSize

Companion primitives for computing the device buffer size (in bytes) required by the CrossCorrFull_NormLevel primitives.

### CommonFullNormLevelGetBufferHostSizeParameters[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__crosscorrfullnormlevel_1CommonFullNormLevelGetBufferHostSizeParameters)

Common parameters for nppiFullNormLevelGetBufferHostSize functions include:

- param oSizeROI
- param hpBufferSize
-
Required buffer size. Important: hpBufferSize is a

*host pointer.*[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). - param nppStreamCtx

- return
-
NPP_NULL_POINTER_ERROR if hpBufferSize is 0 (NULL),

[ROI Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_error_codes).

## Image Cross Correlation Same Norm Level[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-cross-correlation-same-norm-level)

### CrossCorrSame_NormLevel[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__crosscorrsamenormlevel_1crosscorrsamenormlevel)

Primitives for computing the normalized cross correlation coefficient between two images with same mode.

CrossCorrSame_NormLevel

The functions compute the \(\gamma_{st}(c,r)\) in [General Introduction](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__proximity_1general_introduction) with same mode (see [Categorizations](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__proximity_1category)).

The functions require additional scratch buffer for computations.

Note: For maximum performance oSrcRoiSize.width MUST be an integer multiple of 4.

-

SameNormLevelGetBufferHostSize

### CommonSameNormLevelGetBufferHostSizeParameters[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__crosscorrsamenormlevel_1CommonSameNormLevelGetBufferHostSizeParameters)

Common parameters for nppiSameNormLevelGetBufferHostSize functions include:

- param oSizeROI
- param hpBufferSize
-
Required buffer size. Important: hpBufferSize is a

*host pointer.*[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). - param nppStreamCtx

- return
-
NPP_NULL_POINTER_ERROR if hpBufferSize is 0 (NULL),

[ROI Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_error_codes).

## Image Cross Correlation Valid Norm Level[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-cross-correlation-valid-norm-level)

### CrossCorrValid_NormLevel[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__crosscorrvalidnormlevel_1crosscorrvalidnormlevel)

Primitives for computing the normalized cross correlation coefficient between two images with valid mode.

CrossCorrValid_NormLevel

The functions compute the \(\gamma_{st}(c,r)\) in [General Introduction](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__proximity_1general_introduction) with valid mode (see [Categorizations](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__proximity_1category)).

The functions require additional scratch buffer for computations.

Note: For maximum performance oSrcRoiSize.width - oTplRoiSize + 1 MUST be an integer multiple of 4.

ValidNormLevelGetBufferHostSize

Companion primitives for computing the device buffer size (in bytes) required by the CrossCorrValid_NormLevel primitives.

### CommonValidNormLevelGetBufferHostSizeParameters[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__crosscorrvalidnormlevel_1CommonValidNormLevelGetBufferHostSizeParameters)

Common parameters for nppiValidNormLevelGetBufferHostSize functions include:

- param oSizeROI
- param hpBufferSize
-
Required buffer size. Important: hpBufferSize is a

*host pointer.*[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). - param nppStreamCtx

- return
-
NPP_NULL_POINTER_ERROR if hpBufferSize is 0 (NULL),

[ROI Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_error_codes).

## Image Cross Correlation Full Norm Level Advanced[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-cross-correlation-full-norm-level-advanced)

### CrossCorrFull_NormLevelAdvanced[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__crosscorrfullnormlevelAdvanced_1crosscorrfullnormlevelAdvanced)

Primitives for computing the normalized cross correlation coefficient between two images with full mode with large image template sizes.

CrossCorrFull_NormLevelAdvanced

The functions compute the \(\gamma_{st}(c,r)\) in [General Introduction](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__proximity_1general_introduction) with full mode (see [Categorizations](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__proximity_1category)).

The functions require an additional scratch buffer and advanced scratch buffer for computations.

Note: For maximum performance oSrcRoiSize.width + oTplRoiSize.width - 1 MUST be an integer multiple of 4.

## Image Cross Correlation Same Norm Level Advanced[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-cross-correlation-same-norm-level-advanced)

### CrossCorrSame_NormLevelAdvanced[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__crosscorrsamenormlevelAdvanced_1crosscorrsamenormlevelAdvanced)

Primitives for computing the normalized cross correlation coefficient between two images with same mode with large image template sizes.

CrossCorrSame_NormLevelAdvanced

The functions compute the \(\gamma_{st}(c,r)\) in [General Introduction](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__proximity_1general_introduction) with same mode (see [Categorizations](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__proximity_1category)).

The functions require and additional scratch buffer and advanced scratch buffer for computations.

Note: For maximum performance oSrcRoiSize.width MUST be an integer multiple of 4.

## Image Cross Correlation Valid Norm Level Advanced[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-cross-correlation-valid-norm-level-advanced)

### CrossCorrValid_NormLevelAdvanced[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__crosscorrvalidnormlevelAdvanced_1crosscorrvalidnormlevelAdvanced)

Primitives for computing the normalized cross correlation coefficient between two images with valid mode with large template sizes.

CrossCorrValid_NormLevelAdvanced

The functions compute the \(\gamma_{st}(c,r)\) in [General Introduction](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__proximity_1general_introduction) with valid mode (see [Categorizations](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__proximity_1category)).

The functions require an additional scratch buffer and advanced scratch buffer for computations.

Note: For maximum performance oSrcRoiSize.width - oTplRoiSize + 1 MUST be an integer multiple of 4.

QualityIndex

QualityIndexGetBufferHostSize

Companion primitives for computing the device buffer size (in bytes) required by the QualityIndex primitives.

### CommonQualityIndexGetBufferHostSizeParameters[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__quality__index_1CommonQualityIndexGetBufferHostSizeParameters)

Common parameters for nppiQualityIndexGetBufferHostSize functions include:

- param oSizeROI
- param hpBufferSize
-
Required buffer size. Important: hpBufferSize is a

*host pointer.*[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). - param nppStreamCtx

- return
-
NPP_NULL_POINTER_ERROR if hpBufferSize is 0 (NULL),

[ROI Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_error_codes).

## Image Maximum Error[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-maximum-error)

### MaximumError[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__maximum__error_1image_maximum_error)

Primitives for computing the maximum error between two images. Given two images \(pSrc1\) and \(pSrc2\) both with width \(W\) and height \(H\), the maximum error is defined as the largest absolute difference between pixels of two images. If the image is in complex format, the absolute value of the complex number is provided.

### Common parameters for nppiMaximumError functions include:[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__maximum__error_1CommonMaximumErrorParameters)

- param pSrc1
- param nSrc1Step
- param pSrc2
- param nSrc2Step
- param oSizeROI
- param pError
-
Device memory pointer to the computed error.

- param pDeviceBuffer
-
Pointer to the required device memory allocation,

[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). - param nppStreamCtx
- return

MaximumErrorGetBufferHostSize

Companion primitives for computing the device buffer size (in bytes) required by the MaximumError primitives.

### CommonMaximumErrorGetBufferHostSizeParameters[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__maximum__error_1CommonMaximumErrorGetBufferHostSizeParameters)

Common parameters for nppiMaximumErrorGetBufferHostSize functions include:

- param oSizeROI
- param hpBufferSize
-
Required buffer size. Important: hpBufferSize is a

*host pointer.*[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). - param nppStreamCtx

- return
-
NPP_NULL_POINTER_ERROR if hpBufferSize is 0 (NULL),

[ROI Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_error_codes).

AverageErrorGetBufferHostSize

Companion primitives for computing the device buffer size (in bytes) required by the NormDiff_Inf primitives.

### CommonAverageErrorGetBufferHostSizeParameters[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__average__error_1CommonAverageErrorGetBufferHostSizeParameters)

- param oSizeROI
- param hpBufferSize
-
Required buffer size. Important: hpBufferSize is a

*host pointer.*[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). - param nppStreamCtx

- return
-
NPP_NULL_POINTER_ERROR if hpBufferSize is 0 (NULL),

[ROI Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_error_codes).

## Image Maximum Relative Error[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-maximum-relative-error)

### MaximumRelativeError[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__maximum__relative__error_1image_maximum_relative_error)

Primitives for computing the maximum relative error between two images. Given two images \(pSrc1\) and \(pSrc2\) both with width \(W\) and height \(H\), the maximum relative error is defined as:

MaximumRelativeError

MaximumRelativeErrorGetBufferHostSize

Companion primitives for computing the device buffer size (in bytes) required by the NormDiff_Inf primitives.

### CommonMaximumRelativeErrorGetBufferHostSizeParameters[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__maximum__relative__error_1CommonMaximumRelativeErrorGetBufferHostSizeParameters)

Common parameters for nppiMaximumRelativeErrorGetBufferHostSize functions include:

- param oSizeROI
- param hpBufferSize
-
Required buffer size. Important: hpBufferSize is a

*host pointer.*[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). - param nppStreamCtx

- return
-
NPP_NULL_POINTER_ERROR if hpBufferSize is 0 (NULL),

[ROI Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_error_codes).

AverageRelativeErrorGetBufferHostSize

Companion primitives for computing the device buffer size (in bytes) required by the NormDiff_Inf primitives.

### CommonAverageRelativeErrorGetBufferHostSizeParameters[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__average__relative__error_1CommonAverageRelativeErrorGetBufferHostSizeParameters)

- param oSizeROI
- param hpBufferSize
-
Required buffer size. Important: hpBufferSize is a

*host pointer.*[Scratch Buffer and Host Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#general_conventions_lb_1general_scratch_buffer). - param nppStreamCtx

- return
-
NPP_NULL_POINTER_ERROR if hpBufferSize is 0 (NULL),

[ROI Related Error Codes](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_error_codes).

## Image Quality Assessment IQA[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-quality-assessment-iqa)

### IQA[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__image__quality__assessment_1image_quality_assessment)

Primitives for computing the image quality between two images, such as MSE, PSNR, SSIM, and MS-SSIM.

MSE

-

## Image Batch Quality Assessment[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-batch-quality-assessment)

### IQABatch[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__batch__image__quality__assessment_1batch_image_quality_assessment)

Primitives for computing the image quality for a batch of image pairs, such as MSE, PSNR, SSIM, and MS-SSIM with a single [Region-Of-Interest (ROI)](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_specification) for all pairs of input images

MSEBatch

-
[NppStatus](https://docs.nvidia.com/nppdefs.html#c.NppStatus)nppiMSEBatch_8u_C1R_Ctx(const[NppiImageDescriptor](https://docs.nvidia.com/nppdefs.html#c.NppiImageDescriptor)*pSrc1BatchList, const[NppiImageDescriptor](https://docs.nvidia.com/nppdefs.html#c.NppiImageDescriptor)*pSrc2BatchList, int nBatchSize,[NppiSize](https://docs.nvidia.com/nppdefs.html#c.NppiSize)oSizeROI,[Npp32f](https://docs.nvidia.com/nppdefs.html#c.Npp32f)*pMSE,[NppiBufferDescriptor](https://docs.nvidia.com/nppdefs.html#c.NppiBufferDescriptor)*pDeviceBufferList,[NppStreamContext](https://docs.nvidia.com/nppdefs.html#c.NppStreamContext)nppStreamCtx)[](https://docs.nvidia.com#c.nppiMSEBatch_8u_C1R_Ctx)

-
1 channel 8-bit unsigned MSE for a batch of image pairs for a single ROI.

Provided oSizeROI will be used for all images passed in pSrc1BatchList and pSrc2BatchList arguments. API user must ensure that provided ROI (oSizeROI) does not go beyond the borders of any of provided images.

- Parameters
-
**pSrc1BatchList**–[Source-Batch-Images Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1source_batch_images_pointer)device memory pointer to the list of device memory image descriptors, per image oSize must be initialized.**pSrc2BatchList**–[Source-Batch-Images Pointer](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1source_batch_images_pointer)device memory pointer to the list of device memory image descriptors, per image oSize must be initialized.**nBatchSize**– Number of[NppiImageDescriptor](https://docs.nvidia.com/nppdefs.html#structnppiimagedescriptor),[NppiBufferDescriptor](https://docs.nvidia.com/nppdefs.html#structnppibufferdescriptor), and new max number structures/values processed in this call (must be > 1).**oSizeROI**–[Region-Of-Interest (ROI)](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_specification)ROI width and height of ALL images in the batch, MUST match the ROI used when the label markers UF image was generated.**pMSE**– Device memory pointer to output array of the computed MSE for nBatchSize * sizeof(Npp32f) * 1 image pairs.**pDeviceBufferList**– Device memory pointer to the list of[NppiBufferDescriptor](https://docs.nvidia.com/nppdefs.html#structnppibufferdescriptor)buffer descriptors specifying per image device memory buffer pointers and size as returned by at least one nppiMSEBatchGetBufferHostSize call.**nppStreamCtx**–[Application Managed Stream Context](https://docs.nvidia.com/nppdefs.html#structnppstreamcontext_1application_managed_stream_context).

- Returns


-
[NppStatus](https://docs.nvidia.com/nppdefs.html#c.NppStatus)nppiMSEBatch_8u_C3R_Ctx(const[NppiImageDescriptor](https://docs.nvidia.com/nppdefs.html#c.NppiImageDescriptor)*pSrc1BatchList, const[NppiImageDescriptor](https://docs.nvidia.com/nppdefs.html#c.NppiImageDescriptor)*pSrc2BatchList, int nBatchSize,[NppiSize](https://docs.nvidia.com/nppdefs.html#c.NppiSize)oSizeROI,[Npp32f](https://docs.nvidia.com/nppdefs.html#c.Npp32f)*pMSE,[NppiBufferDescriptor](https://docs.nvidia.com/nppdefs.html#c.NppiBufferDescriptor)*pDeviceBufferList,[NppStreamContext](https://docs.nvidia.com/nppdefs.html#c.NppStreamContext)nppStreamCtx)[](https://docs.nvidia.com#c.nppiMSEBatch_8u_C3R_Ctx)

-
3 channel 8-bit unsigned MSE for a batch of image pairs for a single ROI.

Provided oSizeROI will be used for all images passed in pSrc1BatchList and pSrc2BatchList arguments. API user must ensure that provided ROI (oSizeROI) does not go beyond the borders of any of provided images.

## Image Advanced Batch Quality Assessment[](https://docs.nvidia.com#image-advanced-batch-quality-assessment)

### IQABatchAdvanced[](https://docs.nvidia.com#group__batch__image__quality__assessment__advanced_1batch_image_quality_assessment_advanced)

Primitives for computing the image quality for a batch of image pairs, such as MSE, PSNR, SSIM, and MS-SSIM with per-image [Region-Of-Interest (ROI)](https://docs.nvidia.com/introduction.html#nppi_conventions_lb_1roi_specification)
